name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B
notes: Architecture is Llama-3.1-8B's: LlamaForCausalLM, hidden 4096, 32 layers, 32 query heads / 8 KV heads, rope_theta 500000, no rope_scaling, 131072 native. head_dim derived as 4096 / 32 = 128. gqa_ratio = 32 / 8 = 4. vocab_size 128256 with tie_word_embeddings false adds ~525M params of embedding. KV bytes/token at bf16 (2 bytes/element): 32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 head_dim x 2 (K and V) x 2 bytes = 131072 B/token = 128.0 KiB/token. At 128k context that is 16.00 GiB of KV for one sequence at bf16.
